content.text: **Summary**: I investigated ticket T-2009 and found that the pricing-engine pods are crashing due to an application-level bug, not a Kubernetes issue. The pods are panicking when compiling a specific pricing rule with an array index out of bounds error. Kubernetes is functioning correctly by keeping the pods in CrashLoopBackOff. The development team needs to fix the off-by-one error in the tier lookup logic and redeploy the application.
